# Abilities

<!-- Generated by `composer docs:generate` from the operation registry. Do not edit this file: change the declaration and regenerate. -->

SEOCart registers an ability for each operation that declares one, in the ability category `seocart`. An ability runs the same application service as the operation's REST route and WP-CLI command, with the same input schema, permission check and error codes. It is exposed to agents and other clients only when its operation allows it, and an operation that is destructive, moves money or reads personal data in bulk never does.

## `seocart/fixture-adjust-stock`

Adjusts the stock level of one fixture item by a signed change.

- Operation: `fixture_stock.adjust_stock`
- Capability: `seocart_manage_inventory`
- Error codes: `fixture_stock.insufficient` (409)
- Annotations: readonly `false`, destructive `false`, idempotent `false`
- Exposed to agents: no

### Input

- `item_id` (required): Identifier of the stock item whose level is adjusted. A uuid.
- `delta` (required): Signed change to the stock level. A negative value decreases it. An integer from -1000000 to 1000000.
- `reason`: Why the stock level changed. One of `recount`, `damage`, `return`, `correction`. Default `correction`.
- `note`: Free-text note stored with the adjustment. Text of at most 500 characters. Personal data.

### Output

- `item_id` (always): Identifier of the stock item whose level is adjusted. A uuid.
- `on_hand` (always): Stock level of the item after the adjustment. An integer.
- `reason` (always): Why the stock level changed. One of `recount`, `damage`, `return`, `correction`.
- `note`: Free-text note stored with the adjustment, or null when there is none. Text. May be null. Personal data: returned only to a user who holds the capability `seocart_view_customer_pii`.
